**Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2025:** released by **S.P. Singh Baghel** on National Milk Day.
**DAANVEER:** launched by **Vivek Bharadwaj** (Ministry Secretary) at Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi.
**Central GOBARdhan Scheme** (Compressed Biogas sector): launched by Hardeep Singh Puri on **1 October 2026**.
**E85 fuel:** launched in India by Hardeep Singh Puri in June 2026, at New Delhi.
**Green Hydrogen Certification Portal** (National Green Hydrogen Mission): **Pralhad Joshi** was associated with its launch.
**3 MWh Vanadium Redox Flow Battery:** inaugurated by **Manohar Lal Khattar** at NTPC NETRA, Greater Noida.
**National Coastal Mission 2.0 guidelines** (environment and coastal conservation): launched by Bhupender Yadav.

**India's Net Zero Portal and NAPCC Dashboard:** launched by Kirti Vardhan Singh at Mumbai, on World Ozone Day.
**HANSA-3 NG trainer aircraft:** production version launched by Jitendra Singh at CSIR-NAL, Bengaluru.
**Regional Meteorological Centre, Lucknow:** launched by Jitendra Singh, with Yogi Adityanath.
**CSIR-NPL facilities** (environmental and solar-cell calibration facilities): inaugurated by Jitendra Singh.
**Gen V Bano and Mahatma:** book launched by Jitendra Singh.
**Indo-Swiss Research Flagship Event:** attended by Jitendra Singh at New Delhi.
**Advanced 3D chip-packaging unit, Bhubaneswar:** foundation stone laid by **Ashwini Vaishnaw** with Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi.

parts.t: Health, nutrition, women and child development
items: **Arogya Manthan 2026:** inaugurated by Jagat Prakash Nadda on **25 September 2026**; it marked eight years of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
**National Formulary of India, 7th edition:** launched (national-level launch) by Anupriya Patel with biovigilance-related guidance on **21 September 2026**; biovigilance programme.
**Poshan Pakhwada 2026:** national launch led by **Annapurna Devi** on **9 April 2026** at Vigyan Bhavan, New Delhi; **Savitri Thakur** participated.

**Grainage Building and Cold Storage Facility:** inaugurated by Pabitra Margherita at the CSB-Silkworm Seed Production Centre, Rowriah, Jorhat, Assam, on **8 October 2026**.
**Jitan Ram Manjhi:** introduced a legislative measure relating to MSME payments and compliance in the Rajya Sabha on **28 July 2026**.
**Kaushal Setu and Kaushal Sarathi portals:** launched by **Kapil Dev Aggarwal**, Uttar Pradesh.
**L. Murugan:** resigned from both ministerial positions on **13 October 2026**.

lectures.title: Projects in news: defence, space, technology, infrastructure, energy

items: **Project 17A:** follow-on to Project 17 / Shivalik-class frigates; covers **seven** next-generation guided-missile frigates of the Indian Navy.
**Builders:** four ships by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL), Mumbai; three by Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited (GRSE), Kolkata.
**Project 17 / Shivalik class** (Indian Navy): predecessor to Project 17A.
**INS Mahendragiri:** Nilgiri-class Project 17A frigate built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited; commissioned at Visakhapatnam on **11 July 2026**.
**INS Mahendragiri** is the fourth Project 17A frigate built by MDL.
**Project Mahe-class** (Cochin Shipyard Limited, Kochi): Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft programme; **INS Malwan** delivered on 31 March 2026.
**H-561 indigenous ACV** (Indian Coast Guard): indigenous air-cushion vehicle project mentioned in the defence-related material.
Long-range surface-to-air air-defence missile system; tested from APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha
Research Centre Imarat and DRDO laboratories (DRDO ecosystem)
Indigenous glide-weapon project; associated research laboratories are mentioned
Solid Fuel Ducted Ramjet technology programme
Indigenous AI-based vision semiconductor chip; agreement and project assistance mentioned in October 2026
**Kavach** (Indian Railways; RDSO and industry): automatic train protection system; aims to prevent Signal Passing at Danger (SPAD) and reduce collision risks.
**Kavach 4.0** (Indian Railways): improved version of the train-protection system.
Earth-observation satellite mission; scientist Imtiaz Ahmed is the mission Project Director
India's first privately built computing satellite; AI-based data processing in space
Privately developed Indian launch vehicle; developed by Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace
Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and ESA
Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer; joint space mission
Satellite connectivity project mentioned in the space section

**Heterogeneous Integration Packaging Solutions** (3D Glass Solutions): advanced packaging and embedded glass-substrate ATMP facility.
**India Chip Pvt. Ltd.:** HCL–Foxconn joint venture project at Jewar, Uttar Pradesh; foundation stone laid virtually by the Prime Minister.
**Dholera semiconductor fab** (Gujarat): Tata Semiconductor Manufacturing Private Limited; planned capacity of **50,000 wafer starts per month**.
**Commercial Mini/Micro-LED display facility** (Gujarat): Gallium Nitride technology-based facility approved under India Semiconductor Mission.
**Semiconductor assembly and testing project** (Gujarat): discrete semiconductor assembly and testing facility.
**India Semiconductor Mission 2.0** (Government of India): semiconductor ecosystem expansion and manufacturing capability development.
Compact graphics processor for embedded devices; FPGA design demonstrated, ASIC development planned
University engagement programme for AI development
AI education and technology development initiative

parts.t: River link, airport, metro and expressways
items: **Ken–Betwa River Link Project** (Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh): first of the 30 proposed river-linking projects; launched by the Prime Minister on **25 December 2024**; Government of India and participating states.
**Noida International Airport – Phase I** (Jewar, Uttar Pradesh): inaugurated on **28 March 2026**; cost approximately ₹11,200 crore.
**Noida International Airport developer:** Yamuna International Airport Private Limited / Zurich Airport group.
**Chennai Metro Rail Phase II** (Tamil Nadu): Poonamallee–Vadapalani section inaugurated on 11 October 2026; cost approximately ₹4,900 crore.
**Ahmedabad Metro Phase 2A** (Gujarat): approved by Union Cabinet on 10 June 2026; 6.032 km, five stations and cost of ₹2,169.04 crore.
**Seven High-Speed Rail Corridors** (India): combined estimated length nearly 4,000 km.
**Digha–Kankarbagh wastewater project** (Patna): Bihar Urban Infrastructure Development Corporation.

parts.t: Tamil Nadu and Puducherry: highways, railways and ports
items: Railway infrastructure project inaugurated in October 2026
Five redeveloped stations inaugurated: Palani, Vellore Cantonment, Ambasamudram, Paramakkudi and Namakkal
Paved Storage Yard, four EXIM godowns, upgraded Cruise Terminal and Seafarers Club
Port infrastructure project inaugurated by the Prime Minister
Shipbuilding and maritime industrial development project
Proposed first mega Greenfield shipyard; tripartite MoU signed on 20 April 2026

**Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA):** SPV approved by Union Cabinet on **6 October 2026**; apex institution for integrated transport planning and project appraisal (Government of India; national).
**National Maritime Heritage Complex** (Lothal, Gujarat): maritime heritage development project.
**Yuge Yugeen Bharat National Museum** (New Delhi): proposed national museum project in North and South Blocks.
**Singapore–Malaysia–Hyderabad cable project** (international connectivity): high-capacity cable estimated at 3,600 km from Singapore to Machilipatnam, with onward connectivity to Hyderabad.

parts.t: Energy: geothermal, hydrogen, LNG and nuclear
items: **Puga Geothermal Power Project** (Ladakh): 1 MW pilot demonstration-scale geothermal power project; Government / Ladakh administration.
**Twin geothermal wells** (Puga, Ladakh; Ladakh administration): located at approximately 14,000 feet; temperature of 135°C recorded at 400 metres depth.
**Green Hydrogen Certification Portal** (MNRE / NeGD): launched on **17 June 2026**; provides a digital certification mechanism for green hydrogen produced in India.
**Green Hydrogen and derivative projects** (India): renewable-energy capacity development associated with green hydrogen.
**India's first hydrogen fuel-cell train** (Jind–Sonipat, Haryana): inaugurated on 17 July 2026; hydrogen storage, refuelling and operating infrastructure included.
**India's first LNG-powered train** (Sabarmati, Ahmedabad): flagged off on 27 September 2026; LNG introduced into railway propulsion.
**India's first port-based e-methanol production plant** (Kandla, Gujarat): foundation stone laid on 26 September 2026; joint initiative of Deendayal Port Authority and Assam Petro-Chemicals Limited.
**Vanadium Redox Flow Battery** (NTPC NETRA, Greater Noida): 3 MWh battery inaugurated on 11 November 2025.
**Small Hydro Power Development Scheme** (India): approved by Union Cabinet on 18 March 2026; outlay ₹2,584.60 crore.
**Dholera Special Investment Region** (Gujarat): UAE participation covered by a Letter of Intent in January 2026.
**Jaitapur Nuclear Power Project** (Maharashtra): progress discussed in India–France cooperation.
**Central GOBARdhan Scheme** (Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas): Central Sector Scheme for compressed biogas development.
**Central GOBARdhan Scheme – scope:** organic waste and cattle dung-to-biogas development; development of compressed biogas and waste-to-energy projects.
**Cooperative Biogas for Growth Initiative** (India): supports approximately 1,000 biogas and organic-fertiliser plants through dairy cooperatives.
**First cooperative multi-feed CBG plant** (Bio-CNG plant, Kopargaon, Maharashtra): inaugurated on **5 October 2025**.
**Bio-CNG and Fertilizer Plant** (Vav–Tharad, Gujarat): inaugurated on **6 December 2025** by Amit Shah.
India signed wildlife conservation agreement with Namibia
Project Cheetah launched at Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh; eight Namibian cheetahs initially released into quarantine enclosures
**Project GIB** (Great Indian Bustard conservation): three chicks under Project GIB.
**Project Him Sarovar** (Ladakh): twin flower-field project at approximately 10,600 feet; covers around 40 acres.
**National Coastal Mission 2.0** (MoEFCC): coastal ecosystem and conservation programme; outlay ₹767 crore, according to the ministry-related section.
**Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam** (India): tree plantation initiative.
**Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary AI project** (Maharashtra): AI-powered bird detection and monitoring centre proposed.
**Marine Fish Farming Project** (Andaman Sea): India's first open-sea marine fish farming project, launched on **18 January 2026** by Jitendra Singh; Government of India / relevant research bodies.
**Climate-Resilient Village project** (Killai, Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu): implemented under Tamil Nadu Climate Change Mission.
**Bharat-VISTAAR:** farmer-centric AI-powered agricultural Digital Public Infrastructure; launched on 17 February 2026 in Jaipur by Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
**Bharat-VISTAAR – use:** AI-based farm advisory and agricultural information platform.
**Mini Nandini Krishak Samriddhi Yojana:** dairy development under Nand Baba Krishak Dugdh Mission; supports 10 indigenous cows of Sahiwal, Gir or Tharparkar breeds.
**Nandini Krishak Samriddhi Yojana:** supports 25-cow dairy units in 57 districts.
**Fish Brood Bank Project:** Bihar's first Fish Brood Bank established at Raghopur Bakhri, Dumra, Sitamarhi, under PMMSY (Bihar government).
**ICAR post-harvest research project:** research programme by ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana; Phase I budget ₹3.28 crore for two years.
**Aadi Farmer Carbon Programme:** farmer carbon programme mentioned in the environment/agriculture material.
